test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence which gives the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. A piece of cake

options.text: After months of practice, Emily performed her piano piece flawlessly during the concert
The restaurant was crowded, but they found a table without any difficulty.
Despite the heavy rain, they managed to have a successful outdoor event.
The puzzle was so challenging that it took hours for Sam to solve it.

solution:
The correct answer is** Optional 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A piece of cake"** means something **that is very easy to do**. (बहुत आसान काम)

 
 
• **Example:** The exam was **a piece of cake **for Sarah; she finished it in just 20 minutes.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The restaurant was crowded, but they found **a table without any difficulty.** (रेस्टोरेंट भीड़भाड़ वाला था, लेकिन उन्हें आसानी से एक टेबल मिल गई।)
 
 
• **Example:** Finding a parking spot was **a piece of cake** today.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: '**Option 2**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 1: **After months of practice, Emily performed her piano piece flawlessly during the concert. (कई महीनों के अभ्यास के बाद, एमिली ने कॉन्सर्ट में अपने पियानो का टुकड़ा बिना गलती के प्रस्तुत किया।)

 
 
• **Example:** The project was challenging, but after hard work, it was completed successfully.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: **Despite the heavy rain, they managed to have a successful outdoor event. (भारी बारिश के बावजूद, उन्होंने एक सफल आउटडोर कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया।)
 
 
• **Example:** The event was not a piece of cake, but they managed to pull it off.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: **The puzzle was so challenging that it took hours for Sam to solve it. (पहेली इतनी चुनौतीपूर्ण थी कि सैम को इसे हल करने में घंटों लग गए।)
 
 
• **Example:** Solving that puzzle was definitely not a piece of cake.
 
 

3a:Tcce,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
